content.title: Where to Watch WWE Wrestlemania 42 Online
content.text: Skip to main content Where to Watch WWE Wrestlemania 42 Online Wrestling’s biggest event is back with a stacked lineup of matches this weekend. Here’s where to watch it all Elsa/Getty Images If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission. Wrestling’s biggest weekend is upon us with WWE WrestleMania 42 going down in Las Vegas on Saturday and Sunday. As always, the event is stacked with matches featuring WWE’s stars. Eight of the weekend’s 13 matches are for championships, and the other matches also feature big names and celebrities like Logan Paul and IShowSpeed. At a Glance: Where to Stream Wrestlemania 42 Saturday’s headliner will be a battle between Randy Orton and Cody Rhodes for the latter’s undisputed WWE championship. Recently, it was revealed that football analyst Pat McAfee was the one secretly pushing Orton to betray Rhodes and challenge him for the championship, and McAfee has stated he will leave WWE if Orton falls to Rhodes on Saturday. On Sunday night, the big draw will be heavyweight champion CM Punk vs. Royal Rumble winner Roman Reigns. Reigns, who lost his undisputed championship at WrestleMania 40, is looking to climb his way back to the top of WWE. Where to Stream Wrestlemania 42 Online WrestleMania, along with other WWE programming, has a new home on the ESPN app. To stream WrestleMania 42, fans will need a subscription to ESPN Unlimited, which costs $29.99 a month. However, you can get ESPN Unlimited for free (for a limited time) with a free trial to DirecTV or Fubo. These will let you watch Wrestlemania 42 for free. DirecTV, which offers a five-day free trial, carries ESPN Unlimited in its MySports, Entertainment, Choice, and Ultimate plans. Fubo offers ESPN Unlimited in its Sports + News, Pro, and Elite packages, which all start with a five-day free trial. ESPN Unlimited The streaming home of WWE DirecTV Get ESPN Unlimited free trial in MySports, Entertainment, Choice, and Ultimate plans. Fubo Get ESPN Unlimited free trial in Sports + News, Pro, and Elite plans. When Is Wrestlemania 42? 2026 Dates, Start Times Wrestlemania 42 is happening Saturday and Sunday, April 18 and 19. On both nights, the main show starts at 6 p.m. ET after a countdown show that starts at 3 p.m. ET.
